Priya (ProdMktg): Quick sync: run a small PLG experiment for webinar attendees. Offer = 50 credits + 3-prompt 'Launch Pack' injected in-product. Hypothesis: credits + templates -> higher D7 activation. Need short playbook and metrics.

Aisha (Growth): Can we A/B credits (50 vs 100) and CTA copy? Recommend 'Start with template' vs 'Claim credits'.

Tom - Content: I27ll draft 3 short nudges: immediate + recording, how-to modal, 48h tip. ETA Tue.

Leif (DevEx): I can inject pack via internal API and add a one-time modal with "Run sample now" CTA. Will QA.

Evan (Data): I'll provide baseline D0-D7 activation and instrument events: webinar_attend, pack_injected, pack_used, tokens_24h. Dashboard by Wed.
